lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately 10-12 identifiable vertical columns along the visible mid-flank, forming a grid-like pattern with increasing inter-blob spacing toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary high-luminance blobs, creating a series of nodes where the vertical bands and horizontal alignment of blobs meet.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally; a central dorsal ridge and two lateral carinae exhibit a sharp intensity gradient with highlights on the upper boundary and shadowing on the lower boundary.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated along the anterior margin and the basal region of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A long, slender biological attachment, characterized by a dark dorsal surface and lighter ventral pixels, is visible trailing from the ventral-lateral region posterior to the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cranial region displays a significantly higher density of smaller, irregularly shaped high-luminance spots compared to the organized, larger blobs on the trunk and flank.
